notes: Left English on purpose: Integrity Desk (dev-only, base 17097-17170, ~25 strings); Vault God Mode dev jump (17680-17689, 17801-17807, ~7 strings); Skyfall simulator speed bar / End (dev sim, 18673-18675); dead if(false) Island sprite block (17443-17463).

Names kept English: WAR_LANE_NAMES tower names (18818), gear/fragment/sub names, quality tiers (Grey/Green/Blue +2 ... used as data and compared), gear slot names (d.slot / eq.slot, compared via gearSlotSel), boss rule name (vaultBossLabel), guild/player names, hero roles in Skyfall picker (uppercased role data), roster class buttons (19626, compared).
Server-sent text left as-is (langMsg/err.* handle r.error): r.error, rule.warn, q.note, economy manifest sources/sinks/caps (server data), m.round, rd.name.

Not translated: skyStageNow() PREP/MARCH/DONE pill (18724) - the values are compared and line 20027 (outside this range) rewrites the pill; translate both together. Weekday initials S M T W T F S (19472) and date formats (skyWhen/hhmm use en-US + ET) left as is. 'EGP'/'EDP' patron badge abbreviations (17349) and 'T{n}' temper badge left.
CURRENCY_META entries gained a 3rd element (econ.* key), shown via t(meta[2]); GEAR_STAT_LABEL kept as-is, gearStatLabel() looks up gear.stat_<snake_key> and falls back to the English label.
Skyfall schedule band rows gained nk (key) - x.n stays English because 19437 compares x.n==='Last bell'; SKYTEAM.msg==='Saved.' compare now compares against t('skyfall.team_saved').
